checks.name: Elbow
checks.detailed_advice: Your front elbow is too bent ('chicken wing'). This significantly reduces power. Practice the 'wall drill' - stand near a wall and practice your swing ensuring your front arm extends fully without hitting the wall.

checks.name: Head
checks.detailed_advice: Your head is moving too much (dipping or falling away). This causes you to lose sight of the ball. Practice the 'nose over toes' drill - your nose should stay over your front toe throughout the shot. Try batting with a cap and place a tennis ball on top to train stability.

checks.name: BackFoot
checks.detailed_advice: Excellent back foot stability! Your base is solid, allowing proper weight transfer. This foundation is key to generating power.

checks.name: Hips
checks.detailed_advice: Perfect hip rotation! You're generating excellent power through your lower body. This aggressive rotation is exactly what's needed for this shot.

checks.name: Finish
checks.detailed_advice: Your follow-through is incomplete - hands stopping low. This means you're decelerating through the shot, losing power. Practice 'full swing drills' where you exaggerate the follow-through. Your hands should finish HIGH - near or above your opposite shoulder. Think 'throw the bat over your shoulder' (but controlled!).

form_analysis.summary: Form needs significant correction on stability and timing.
form_analysis.enhanced_summary: ❌ Form needs significant work. Don't worry - everyone starts somewhere! Focus on improving: Elbow, Head, Finish. Keep practicing and you'll see improvement!
